floor_plan: Corridor runs left-right. Apartment door open on the far wall. Mara stands in the corridor at screen left; Eli stands in the doorway at screen right. A closed cardboard box sits inside the apartment behind Eli.

light.direction: warm key from inside the apartment, falling on Eli's right side and Mara's left side
light.color: warm tungsten with cooler corridor fill
light.source: practical ceiling light inside the apartment

ambience: quiet corridor room tone; distant building hum; no music

axis_180.description: Camera stays on the corridor side of the Mara–Eli line. Mara always looks screen right toward Eli; Eli always looks screen left toward Mara.
